name: apple-vision-mcp
description: OCR and barcode reading for images and scanned PDFs through Vision
long_description:
A local MCP server written in Swift for optical character recognition: reads text out of an image (PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF…) or out of a scanned PDF, page by page, through Vision's VNRecognizeTextRequest. A second tool reads QR codes and barcodes from the same files through VNDetectBarcodesRequest, returning each code's symbology, payload and box.

For a PDF, PDFKit is used only to rasterize each page into a bitmap — this server never reads a PDF's own text layer, outline or metadata. That is apple-pdf-mcp's job, and it is faster and more accurate whenever a PDF actually has a text layer. Try pdf_read first on any PDF; vision_ocr is what reads the scan pdf_read cannot.

Every result is bounded and says what it left out: a long scan is read a few pages at a time, a page of text longer than one result in windows, and the codes of a file a page of them at a time, with the exact arguments for the rest in the first lines. Recognition takes seconds a page, so a call that runs long is cut short between pages and marked partial, and one that never finishes is abandoned with an error; a page already being recognised cannot be interrupted.

The folder list below is the ONE deliberate exception to "nothing to configure" in this family of extensions: it is the security boundary itself, not a preference, so there is no sensible default to hardcode in its place. Leaving it blank means reading nothing; guessing one would mean guessing what may be exposed.

This server never writes anything and has no delete of any kind.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple Inc.

tools.name: vision_status
tools.description: Reports which folders this server may read, a page at a time, and whether macOS is actually letting it reach them. Reads no file contents.

tools.name: vision_ocr
tools.description: Runs Vision's text recognition over an image (PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF…) or over PDF pages, rendering each page first. Returns the recognised lines in reading order, whole pages up to about one result at a time; the first lines say which pages it holds and how to read the rest.

tools.name: vision_barcodes
tools.description: Runs Vision's barcode detection over an image or PDF pages, rendering each page first. Returns the codes found a page at a time, in a stated order, each with its symbology, decoded payload and pixel box.

read_roots.title: Folders Claude may read
read_roots.description: Claude can run OCR and barcode reading on any image or PDF inside these. Nothing outside them is reachable.
